info.title: AI & Developer 20-in-1 Utility Suite (RapidAPI Ready)
info.description: Production-ready collection of 20 high-demand APIs built for RapidAPI monetization with $0.00 COGS. Includes Web2Markdown, B2B Lead Enrichment, SEO Audit, Email Verifier, YouTube Transcript, PII Redactor, JSON Repair, Password Auditor, Cron Parser, Text Analytics, Token Cost Estimator, Markdown-to-TTS Cleaner, RAG Chunker, Prompt Injection Scanner, Vector Math, Citation Extractor, Prompt Template Hydrator, Text Deduplicator, Regex Tester, and Code Language Detector.

post.summary: Convert any URL to clean LLM-ready Markdown & metadata
Extract emails, phones, social profiles, and tech stack from any company domain
Perform a 0-100 Technical SEO & AI Search (GEO) audit on any webpage
Verify email syntax, live DNS MX records, disposable domains, and B2B status

tags: 5. YouTube Transcript, Metadata & Viral Hook Extractor
post.summary: Extract timestamped transcript, opening 30s viral hook, and pacing metrics from YouTube

tags: 6. Smart PII Redaction & Data Sanitizer for LLMs
post.summary: Redact PII (emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards, IPs, API keys) with reversible token map

tags: 7. LLM Output Repair & Messy JSON Parser
post.summary: Extract and deterministically repair broken or markdown-wrapped JSON from LLM outputs
Calculate password entropy, offline GPU crack time, and scan text for leaked API secrets

tags: 9. Universal Cron, Natural Language Schedule & Timezone
post.summary: Validate cron or natural text, explain in plain English, and compute next N execution times
Compute Flesch-Kincaid readability, lexical diversity, sentiment polarity, and top SEO keywords
Estimate input/output token counts and round-trip costs across top LLM models

tags: 12. Markdown to Clean Plain Text & TTS Formatter
post.summary: Strip Markdown tags, links, and code fences into clean plain text for TTS and speech pipelines
Segment text into overlapping chunks optimized for RAG embeddings and Vector DBs
Detect prompt injection, jailbreak keywords, and system prompt leakage attempts
Compute high-speed dot product, cosine similarity and distance between two embedding vectors
Normalize an embedding vector to unit length (L2 normalization)
Extract footnote citations, URLs, and source brackets from unstructured LLM answers
Safely inject variables into {{variable}} prompt templates with missing-field validation
Remove repetitive sentence and paragraph loops often generated by local or small LLMs
Validate, test, and extract matches with indices and plain-English regex token explanations
Identify programming language, runtime, and structure of code snippets for AI agent pipelines
